gloss: to go out to meet, to greet, to welcome

definitions.gloss: to go out to meet, to greet
definitions.explanation: To go to a place to meet and welcome someone who is arriving.
To greet someone upon their arrival.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}に{友人|ゆうじん}を{出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the airport to meet my friend.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}で{お客様|おきゃくさま}を{出迎|でむか}えた。
examples.english: I greeted the guest at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {大勢|おおぜい}のファンが{選手|せんしゅ}たちを{出迎|でむか}えた。
examples.english: A large crowd of fans welcomed the players.

notes:
{出迎|でむか}える is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to go out to meet and welcome someone.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {出|で}る (to go out) + {迎|むか}える (to greet) → to go out to greet

TRANSITIVITY:
- {出迎|でむか}える ({他動詞|たどうし}): to go out to meet someone
- Opposite: {見送|みおく}る (to see off)

ASPECT (ている):
{出迎|でむか}えている indicates waiting to greet someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {空港|くうこう}に{出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}く (go to the airport to meet)
- {駅|えき}まで{出迎|でむか}える (meet at the station)
- {笑顔|えがお}で{出迎|でむか}える (greet with a smile)

RELATED NOUN:
- {出迎|でむか}え: greeting, reception; {出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}く = go to meet

OPPOSITE:
- {見送|みおく}る: to see off (when someone is leaving)
